Duke ECE lists Reif in its faculty directory; his ECE profile lists him as professor of computer science and mechanical engineering but omits an ECE position. His Duke-hosted CV reports a secondary ECE appointment since June 2016. The department faculty listing establishes the affiliation under this policy; the conflicting omission does not establish a more specific current appointment subtype.

findings.description: Reif appears on the ECE faculty directory, while his official profile and CS directory omit ECE in positions. His Duke-hosted CV asserts a secondary ECE appointment; classified affiliate_professor using the official ECE faculty listing and current professorship, without inferring a joint/courtesy subtype. This conflict merits reconciliation.
The official announcement specifies Datta as an incoming ECE chair beginning 2027-07-15.
